faqs.question: Can the TFAS unit be concealed above a false ceiling?
faqs.answer: Yes! The low-profile matte-black industrial enclosure features integrated suspension brackets and dual duct collars specifically designed to fit seamlessly inside residential and commercial false ceilings.

faqs.question: How does positive pressurization stop window dust infiltration?
faqs.answer: By continuously introducing filtered fresh air, indoor barometric pressure becomes slightly higher than outdoor pressure, preventing polluted city smog from seeping in through window gaps and door frames.

items.overview: Traditional mechanical filters are passive—contaminants must be drawn all the way back into the return duct to be trapped. The IntelliGreen Active Needlepoint Bi-Polar Ionisation (BPI) Module transforms your supply air itself into an active purifying agent. By generating a dense, balanced cloud of positive (H+) and negative (O2-) ions with zero ozone byproduct, it neutralizes viruses, bacteria, VOCs, and ultrafine particulates directly in the occupied room.
applications: Hospital Operating Theaters, ICUs & Isolation Wards
High-Density Open-Plan Offices, Auditoriums & Airports
Integration Module for IntelliGreen TFAS & ERV Systems
Central HVAC Air Handling Units (AHUs) & VRF Fan Coils

workingMechanism.title: Needlepoint Corona Discharge
workingMechanism.description: Precision voltage-regulated needlepoint electrodes split ambient water vapor molecules into balanced positive (H+) and negative (O2-) ions without producing ozone.

workingMechanism.title: Microbial Surface & Airborne Inactivation
workingMechanism.description: Ions cluster around airborne viruses, bacteria, and mold spores, extracting hydrogen from their surface proteins to render them inactive.

workingMechanism.title: Sub-Micron Particle Agglomeration
workingMechanism.description: Oppositely charged ultrafine particles attract and clump into larger clusters, settling out of the breathing zone or getting easily trapped by filters.

faqs.question: Does the BPI module produce harmful ozone?
faqs.answer: No. Unlike legacy corona-tube ionizers, our needlepoint BPI circuit is voltage-clamped below the ozone activation threshold and is independently validated to UL 2998 Zero-Ozone standards (<0.005 ppm).

faqs.question: Can this module be added to the IntelliGreen TFAS unit or an existing AHU?
faqs.answer: Yes! It mounts directly into the dedicated BPI slot inside our TFAS/ERV units or bolts onto any standard HVAC supply duct/AHU coil face in under 15 minutes.

items.overview: Introducing untreated outdoor air in extreme Indian summers or winters forces air conditioning chillers to work overtime. The IntelliGreen Cross-Flow ERV (Energy Recovery Ventilator) solves the energy-vs-ventilation dilemma. Its internal diamond enthalpy core pre-cools and dehumidifies incoming hot outdoor air using the coolness of outgoing stale exhaust air—delivering 100% filtered fresh air while recovering up to 78% of thermal energy.

High-Occupancy Conference Halls, Classrooms & Co-Working Floors

faqs.question: Does exhaust air mix with the fresh incoming air inside the ERV core?
faqs.answer: Zero mixing occurs. The cross-flow enthalpy core consists of sealed alternating plates that transfer only thermal energy and water vapor molecules across a selective membrane while keeping exhaust pollutants 100% isolated.

faqs.question: How much HVAC electricity does an ERV save?
faqs.answer: By pre-cooling incoming 42°C summer air down to ~27°C using outgoing 24°C room exhaust, the ERV reduces fresh-air air conditioning load by up to 65–75%.

items.overview: The EAC Electronic Air Cleaner relies on fundamental principles of Electrostatic Precipitation to deliver high-capacity micro-particle collection without restricting HVAC airflow. Engineered with a dual-stage setup featuring an initial Charging Section and a subsequent Collector Section, airborne particles are positively charged and attracted to oppositely charged collection plates. Officially GreenPro certified by CII–IGBC.
applications: Commercial Office Air Handling Units (AHUs)
Industrial Manufacturing Facilities & Metal Workshops
Data Centers & Mission-Critical Server Rooms
Commercial Kitchen Exhaust & Hospital Plenums

workingMechanism.title: Collector Section (Electrostatic Capture)
workingMechanism.description: Charged particles enter an intense electrostatic field between oppositely charged aluminum collection plates, trapping micro-pollutants down to 0.01 microns.

workingMechanism.title: Low Resistance Airflow Circulation
workingMechanism.description: Purified air passes through with minimal static pressure drop (<25 Pa), maintaining optimum HVAC energy efficiency with zero disposable filter waste.

faqs.question: What is GreenPro Certification by CII-IGBC?
faqs.answer: GreenPro certification by CII–IGBC validates that the EAC filter meets stringent green building performance criteria, earning direct credits toward IGBC and LEED ratings.

faqs.question: How does electrostatic precipitation compare to standard mechanical bag/HEPA filters?
faqs.answer: Unlike dense mechanical filters that clog and create 150–250 Pa of static pressure resistance, EAC aluminum cells maintain <25 Pa pressure drop and are 100% washable and reusable.
